Your practical questions

What clients ask before mobilization

01 How do you build the estimate?

We begin with the parcel count, identify ownership, study the market, and apply per-acre valuation to the rights required. That foundation gives us the workload, staffing plan, cost, and schedule.

02 How do you work with hesitant landowners?

We listen, answer plainly, and present the offer, rights, and property drawing in writing. Fair treatment and an agent who understands the area help landowners make informed decisions sooner.

When agreement remains out of reach, we keep the file prepared for condemnation support, with ownership interests and the final offer documented, so the remaining parcel doesn't move your in-service date.

03 Can you staff a project this size?

Yes. We recruit through Dudley Land Company's established network and support the field with the systems, land managers, and back-office capacity required to keep the work moving.

04 How do you handle encroachments on a rebuild?

We identify and negotiate encroachments ahead of construction, including the hundreds a rebuild may carry. We also secure the crossing and encroachment agreements required for legal access.
